title: GTA 6 Wallpapers 4K: Free Official Download
description: Rockstar has released official GTA 6 wallpapers, artwork and 138 screenshots. Download 4K GTA 6 wallpapers free, plus the map on Nov 19.

body.text: Rockstar Games has opened a GTA 6 media kit ahead of the game's November 19 launch, with official wallpapers, artwork, screenshots and trailers that fans can download and share. We have picked the best and put them in one place: [download GTA 6 wallpapers in 4K here](/blog/2026-11-04-gta-6-physical-map-poster-free-download-rockstar-store).

items: 27 official artwork pieces and wallpapers, including Jason and Lucia on a rooftop, "Lock and Load" and the album cover art.
138 screenshots of Jason, Lucia and Vice City.
51 screenshots of the Ultimate Edition benefits and 12 from the Vintage Vice City Pack.
Videos including the launch trailer, the pre-load video and character clips of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.

body.text: Six of the best official wallpapers, including the GTA 6 cover art and Vice City, are ready to download in 4K (3840×2160) on our [GTA 6 map and downloads page](/blog/2026-11-04-gta-6-physical-map-poster-free-download-rockstar-store). They work on phones, PCs and TVs.
